# freshdesk_solution_category (Data Source)

Look up a single knowledge-base category by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_solution_category" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the solution category to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the category was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the category.
- `name` (String) Name of the category.
- `updated_at` (String) When the category was last changed (RFC 3339).
- `visible_in_portals` (Set of Number) IDs of the portals the category appears in.
